items.text: Whitney Houston's "So Emotional" and "Where Do Broken Hearts Go" both reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1988, giving her seven consecutive number-one hits.
items.question: Where were you living when Whitney Houston's "Where Do Broken Hearts Go" was on the radio, and who did you know who could sing like her?
source_quote: These are the Billboard magazine Hot 100 number one hits of 1988. The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart that ranks the best-performing singles of the United States.

R&B/pop megastar Whitney Houston's two singles released from her second studio album Whitney, "So Emotional" and "Where Do Broken Hearts Go", both peaked at number one, which gave her a total of seven consecutive number one hits

items.text: The movie Who Framed Roger Rabbit, which mixed animation with live action, was released on June 22, 1988.
items.question: Who did you go see Who Framed Roger Rabbit with, and which theater was it?
items.source_quote: June 22 – Animation/live action crossover movie Who Framed Roger Rabbit is released through Touchstone Pictures.

items.text: NASA resumed Space Shuttle flights on September 29, 1988, when Space Shuttle Discovery went back into orbit.
items.question: Where were you when the Space Shuttle Discovery went back up in September 1988, and who did you watch the launch with?
items.source_quote: September 29 – STS-26: NASA resumes Space Shuttle flights, grounded after the 1986 Space Shuttle Challenger disaster, with Space Shuttle Discovery going back into orbit

items.text: On October 15, 1988, Kirk Gibson hit a home run to win Game 1 of the World Series for the Los Angeles Dodgers over the Oakland Athletics.
items.question: Do you remember Kirk Gibson's home run in the 1988 World Series, and who was in the room when it happened?
items.source_quote: October 15 – Kirk Gibson hits a dramatic home run to win Game 1 of the World Series for the Los Angeles Dodgers, over the Oakland Athletics, by a score of 5–4.
